data.body_html:
The Polo Final 2034 at Santa María Polo Club in Sotogrande is one of the Costa del Sol's most glamorous events. A Sotogrande yacht charter for the polo final 2034 lets you combine world-class polo with the luxury of a private boat. Depart from Puerto Banús, cruise 30 nautical miles south, and anchor off Sotogrande to watch the match from the water. Our fleet includes the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) from €749/2h and the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719/4h, both with licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks included.

Why Choose a Yacht for the Polo Final 2034?

Watching the polo final from a yacht offers privacy, comfort, and a unique vantage point. Instead of crowded stands, you get sunbeds, a cool breeze, and your own bar. The cruise from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande takes just 30-40 minutes, passing Marbella's Golden Mile, Estepona, and the Rock of Gibraltar. You can stop for a swim at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés before the match. After the final, enjoy sunset cocktails on the way back. All our boats are fully equipped with sound systems, shaded areas, and onboard facilities.

Our Fleet for Sotogrande Yacht Charter

We offer two pricing tiers for the polo final. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, inclusive of skipper, fuel, drinks, and IVA. Tier B includes the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) at €4,719 minimum 4 hours, with a free jet ski. For larger groups, boats like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) and Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) are available on request via WhatsApp. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Itinerary: Puerto Banús to Sotogrande

A typical day for the polo final starts at 10:30 at Puerto Banús. Board your yacht, meet the skipper, and set off south. The route hugs the coast, passing the Golden Mile, Marbella Marina, and the dunes of Cabopino. Around 11:30, stop for a swim at Cala Cortés or Cala del Faro. Arrive off Sotogrande by 12:30, anchor near the polo club, and enjoy lunch onboard. The final usually runs from 14:00 to 16:00. After the match, cruise back with sunset views over La Concha mountain. Return to Puerto Banús by 18:00.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. The skipper handles navigation and anchoring, so you can relax. For Tier B boats, a jet ski is included free for 30 minutes. Special requests like catering or champagne can be arranged on request.

Tips for the Polo Final 2034

  • Book early — the polo final is a high-demand event; we recommend 3-6 months advance.
  • Dress smart-casual; white is traditional for polo, but not required.
  • Bring sunscreen and a hat; the sun is strong even in late summer.
  • Consider an 8-hour charter to combine the final with a swim stop and sunset cruise.
  • Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom quotes.

Other Boats for Larger Groups

If you need more space, our fleet includes the Mangusta 80 (Grey) (24m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), and Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax). All depart Puerto Banús. Pricing is on request via WhatsApp. These boats offer multiple decks, cabins, and premium amenities. Ideal for corporate events or large family gatherings.
